entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait for the next available agent.
Hi, you've reached VeloFit. My name is Sarah. How can I help you today?
Oh, hi. I hope you can help. I bought this jersey a little while ago and I... I think I need to send it back. I'm just so confused by the whole process on your website.
I can certainly help you look into that. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with the jersey? Is it a technical fault or a preference issue regarding the fit?
A preference? I guess so. It's just the wrong size. It's way too tight, I can barely zip it up. I think I need to do an exchange for a larger one.
Okay, I completely understand. It's important to have a comfortable fit. Do you have your order number handy so I can look up the purchase details?
Um, yes, I think so. Let me find it... It's VF-774-2189.
Thank you. One moment... Okay, I see the order for the Aero Race Jersey. It looks like it was delivered to you about 31 days ago. Let me just quickly confirm our return policy for you.
Oh, has it been that long? I was so worried I missed the window. Can't you just help me? I don't want to be stuck with it.
Not to worry. I've just checked, and you are well within our 90-day return window. We can absolutely get this sorted out for you.
Oh, what a relief! Thank you. So, what do I do now to get the exchange?

It's very simple. I've just initiated the exchange in our system. I'm sending you an email right now with a pre-paid return label. Just package the original jersey, attach that label, and drop it at the post office. As soon as we get the tracking update, we'll ship out the new size to you.
Wow, that's it? That's so much easier than I thought. Thank you so much, Sarah.
You're very welcome! Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. You've been a huge help.
I'm glad I could help. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
